info.title: ToolHub India API
info.description: B2B industrial tools eShop REST API. All responses use the envelope `{ success, data, meta?, error? }`; errors carry `{ code, message, details? }` with stable codes.

post.description: Registers a B2C/B2B customer and emails a verification OTP. Always 202 with a generic message.

400.description: Validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR) or invalid/expired code (OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS)

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

post.description: Consumes the REGISTER OTP, activates the account and starts a session (sets th_rt + th_csrf cookies).

400.description: Validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR) or invalid/expired code (OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS)

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

post.description: Email + password login. Sets rotating refresh and CSRF cookies.

400.description: Validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR) or invalid/expired code (OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS)

403.description: Email not verified (EMAIL_UNVERIFIED) or account inactive (ACCOUNT_INACTIVE)

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

post.description: Passwordless login step 1: emails a LOGIN OTP to verified users. Always 202 with a generic message.

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

post.description: Passwordless login step 2: consumes the LOGIN OTP and starts a session.

400.description: Validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR) or invalid/expired code (OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS)

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

post.description: Rotates the th_rt refresh cookie. Requires the X-CSRF-Token header (double-submit). Replaying a rotated token revokes the whole family.

200.description: New access token and rotated cookies

post.description: Revokes the presented refresh token and clears session cookies. CSRF-guarded.
Revokes every refresh token of the authenticated user (all devices).
Emails a RESET_PASSWORD OTP to verified users. Always 202 with a generic message.

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

post.description: Consumes the RESET_PASSWORD OTP, sets the new password and revokes all sessions.

400.description: Validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR) or invalid/expired code (OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS)

429.description: Rate limited (RATE_LIMITED), OTP cooldown (OTP_COOLDOWN) or account locked (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

get.description: Current user snapshot (requires Authorization: Bearer).
Live sessions of the current user; `current` marks the session that made the request (sid claim).

delete.description: Revokes every session except the current one ("sign out other devices").
Revokes one session by id. 404 unless it belongs to the caller.

post.description: Changes the password after verifying the current one; revokes every other session and notifies by email.

401.description: Current password wrong (INVALID_CREDENTIALS) or not authenticated

get.description: Lists the caller’s address book.

post.description: Creates an address. Setting isDefaultShipping / isDefaultBilling unsets the previous default of that kind.

patch.description: Partially updates one of the caller’s addresses.

404.description: Address not found (NOT_FOUND) — also when the address belongs to another user

delete.description: Deletes one of the caller’s addresses.

404.description: Address not found (NOT_FOUND) — also when the address belongs to another user

get.description: The B2B company linked to the caller, with its user list.

404.description: No company linked to this account (NOT_FOUND)

get.description: Navigation tree of active categories, `depth` levels deep (default 2, max 10). Cached 5 min.
One active category by code, plus its immediate active children.
Immediate active children of a category, ordered by sortOrder.
Filterable attribute set for a category: its own mapping, or the nearest ancestor mapping (spec 15.3 inheritance).
Category chain from the root down to (and including) this category.

post.description: Creates a category (root when parentId is null). Computes path/pathSlugs/level from the parent in one transaction; slug defaults to the name with a unique suffix on conflict.

patch.description: Applies sibling sortOrders in one transaction. parentId (when present) must match the current parent.
Re-parents a category and recomputes path/pathSlugs/level for the whole moved subtree atomically. Moving under itself or a descendant returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

404.description: Category or new parent not found

patch.description: Partial update. A slug change rewrites pathSlugs for the whole subtree and records CATEGORY SlugRedirect rows (old→new) in the same transaction.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a category; 409 CONFLICT while products or child categories exist.

409.description: Still has products/children (CONFLICT, details { products, children })

get.description: Attribute definitions (flat, grouped client-side). With ?categoryCode= returns the effective mapped set for that category instead (same inheritance as /categories/{code}/filters).
One attribute definition by key.

post.description: Creates an attribute definition. ENUM requires a non-empty, duplicate-free enumValues array.

patch.description: Updates label/labelHtml/groupName/unit/enumValues and (guarded) type. Type changes return 409 CONFLICT while product variant values reference the attribute.

delete.description: Hard-deletes an attribute; 409 CONFLICT while categories or product values reference it.

put.description: REPLACES the category’s attribute mapping with the request array (deleteMany + createMany in one transaction). isVariantAxis requires STRING/ENUM attributes. Body is the bare array.

get.description: All brands with PUBLISHED product counts (computed via groupBy on Product). Cached 5 min.
One brand by slug (logo URL resolved). Product listing by brand lives in the products module.

post.description: Creates a brand. Slug defaults to the name with a unique suffix on conflict; name is unique.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a brand; 409 CONFLICT while products reference it.

get.description: Serves a stored asset by publicId (local adapter only; Cloudinary assets are delivered from res.cloudinary.com). publicIds are immutable, so responses are cacheable for a year and revalidated via ETag. NOTE: this route is mounted at the service root — the real URL is {PUBLIC_API_URL}/media/<publicId>, not under /api/v1.

200.description: Asset bytes (Content-Type per extension, ETag, immutable cache).

post.description: Issues an upload ticket for the active adapter: local returns the publicId to POST raw bytes to /admin/media/upload; cloudinary returns signed REST params (api_key, timestamp, folder, public_id, signature) for a direct browser upload.

Raw binary intake (the local-adapter counterpart of a direct Cloudinary upload). Send the asset bytes as the body with the asset Content-Type, plus an `x-public-id` header (from sign-upload) and an optional `x-mime` override. Max 10MB; magic bytes must match the declared type.

400.description: Validation failed (folder, media type, magic bytes)

get.description: PDP payload by slug — PUBLISHED, non-deleted products only (else 404). Carries brand, category path, ordered images/documents and the active variants with attribute values, price tiers and availability.
One variant by exact articleNo (public visibility rules apply, else 404) — cart/PDP deep links.
Up to 8 related PUBLISHED products from the same category (same brand preferred, self excluded).

Paginated listing (default sort `relevance` ≙ newest-first) with DISJUNCTIVE facet counts (`facets`). Any OTHER query key is an attribute filter: `key=v1,v2` for STRING/ENUM (OR inside the value set), `true`/`false` for BOOLEAN, and `key_min`/`key_max` for inclusive NUMBER ranges — AND across attributes, and a product matches when ONE active variant matches ALL predicates. `q` is parsed but ignored here — ranked full-text search lives at `GET /search`.

400.description: Invalid filter parameter(s) — unknown keys or type misuse, details included

get.description: Paginated listing (default sort `relevance` ≙ newest-first) with DISJUNCTIVE facet counts (`facets`). Any OTHER query key is an attribute filter: `key=v1,v2` for STRING/ENUM (OR inside the value set), `true`/`false` for BOOLEAN, and `key_min`/`key_max` for inclusive NUMBER ranges — AND across attributes, and a product matches when ONE active variant matches ALL predicates. `q` is parsed but ignored here — ranked full-text search lives at `GET /search`. The scope is fixed to the brand; the `brand` filter key is ignored here.

400.description: Invalid filter parameter(s) — unknown keys or type misuse, details included

get.description: Back-office product table: search (name/articleNo prefix), brand/category/status/low-stock filters, sort and pagination.

post.description: Creates a product family. Slug defaults to the name (unique suffix on conflict); the category must exist, be active and be a leaf; the brand must exist. Audited.

409.description: Could not derive a unique slug (CONFLICT)

patch.description: Partial product update. A slug change writes a PRODUCT SlugRedirect (old → new). descriptionHtml is sanitized; audited with a field-level diff.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the product AND its variants (minPrice cleared). 409 when already deleted.

post.description: Creates a variant + attribute values and recomputes product.minPrice in one transaction. articleNo/EAN must be unique; attribute values must satisfy the category mapping; variant-axis combinations must not collide (409 with the conflicting variant).

400.description: Validation failed (mapping, required attributes, lead time)

409.description: articleNo/ean/axis combination already in use (CONFLICT, details included)

patch.description: Partial variant update. `attributes` (when present) merge-replaces the stored values; the final set must satisfy the mapping. minPrice is recomputed. Audited with a field-level diff.

400.description: Validation failed (mapping, required attributes, lead time)

409.description: articleNo/ean/axis combination already in use (CONFLICT, details included)

delete.description: Soft-deletes a variant; the last active variant of a product cannot be deleted (409).

put.description: REPLACES the image list (body = bare array). publicIds must be valid media ids; variantId references must belong to this product. Responds with the new list in display order.

post.description: REPLACES the document list (body = bare array, same semantics as the images PUT). Entries with a publicId resolve to /media/{publicId}; otherwise the url must be an absolute http(s) URL.

put.description: REPLACES the variant’s tier price list (body = bare array; quantities strictly increasing). Responds with the new tiers.

400.description: Tier quantities must be strictly increasing

post.description: Effective unit prices for 1–100 variant lines. Ladder: the caller company’s customer price (validity window including now) > the tier with the highest minQty ≤ quantity > the variant’s list price. Authentication is OPTIONAL — guests resolve list/tier prices; a presented-but-invalid bearer still fails 401. Unknown or inactive variantIds → 404 with details.

200.description: Resolved prices — one entry per line, order preserved

404.description: Unknown or invisible variantId(s) — details { variantIds }

get.description: Ranked full-text search (spec 12) over the weighted Product searchVector (name A, brand + article numbers B, description C) with pg_trgm typo tolerance; exact articleNo/EAN hits rank first and surface as `exactArticleNo` (the frontend can jump straight to that PDP). Filter, sort and pagination semantics are identical to the category listing: every query key beyond the documented ones is an attribute filter (`key=v1,v2`, `key_min`/`key_max`), AND across attributes, one active variant satisfies all predicates, and `facets` carries DISJUNCTIVE counts. Default sort `relevance` is the text ranking itself.

400.description: Invalid 'q' or filter parameter(s) — unknown attribute keys, type misuse or q shorter than 2 chars; details included

get.description: Autocomplete groups for the header search box (spec 6.5): products (exact articleNo/EAN matches first, image + brand), categories and brands. q is trimmed and must be 2–100 characters.

400.description: Invalid 'q' — missing or shorter than 2 chars after trimming

get.description: The GLOBAL filter set for the search page: every attribute that is filterable in ANY category (deduped by attribute), shaped as CategoryAttributeDto rows for the same FilterBar the category pages use.

Homepage composition: active banners per placement (heroes, side top/bottom, highlights — scheduling window respected), the top-level category tiles and homepage SEO. Cached 5 min under `cms:home`; every admin CMS write invalidates the `cms:` prefix.

One PUBLISHED CMS page by slug; drafts 404 like unknown slugs. Blocks are validated against the six-type registry on read — unknown or malformed blocks are dropped and logged (spec 6.11), never a 500.
Active banners of one placement (scheduling window respected when set), ordered by sortOrder. Banner images resolve to `/media/{publicId}` URLs — the raw publicId never leaves the API.

post.description: Creates a banner. `startsAt`/`endsAt` are optional (null = unbounded); audit + `cms:` cache invalidation.

patch.description: Partial banner update with a field-level audit diff.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a banner (the model has no soft-delete columns).

post.description: Upserts a CMS page by slug: 201 when created, 200 when an existing slug was updated. Every block must match the six-type registry (CmsBlockSchema) — unknown types are rejected with 400 here (the read side drops them instead).

400.description: Validation failed (bad slug or a block outside the registry)

patch.description: Partial CMS page update by slug (title/blocks/seoTitle/seoDescription/status). Setting status to DRAFT immediately hides the page from the public endpoint.

get.description: Sitemap index info: the four chunk streams (categories/products/brands/cms) and how many chunks (pages) each carries. Chunks hold at most 45,000 URLs.

One sitemap chunk: 1-based `page` of the given type, max 45,000 locale-prefixed `loc` paths (category `/{pathSlugs}/c/{code}`, product `/p/{slug}-{slugifiedFirstArticleNo}`, `/brands/{slug}`, `/e/{slug}`) with `updatedAt` lastmod where the model has timestamps. Out-of-range pages 404 so stale index data surfaces loudly.
The caller’s cart with server-computed prices (customer price > tier > list), totals (tax from settings, standard shipping estimate) and warnings. Never creates a row.

200.description: The caller’s cart (guest via th_cart cookie, user via bearer)

409.description: Quantity rules rejected the line (OUT_OF_STOCK under STOCK_ONLY policy)

post.description: Add a variant (or increase its line). Quantities are normalised onto the variant’s minOrderQty/packSize grid and the stock policy; adjustments come back as cart warnings. First guest add sets the httpOnly th_cart cookie (60 days).

200.description: The caller’s cart (guest via th_cart cookie, user via bearer)

201.description: The caller’s cart (guest via th_cart cookie, user via bearer)

409.description: Quantity rules rejected the line (OUT_OF_STOCK under STOCK_ONLY policy)

patch.description: Change quantity and/or note of one cart item (scoped to the caller’s cart).

200.description: The caller’s cart (guest via th_cart cookie, user via bearer)

404.description: Item not in the caller’s cart

409.description: Quantity rules rejected the line (OUT_OF_STOCK under STOCK_ONLY policy)

delete.description: Remove one line from the caller’s cart.

200.description: The caller’s cart (guest via th_cart cookie, user via bearer)

404.description: Item not in the caller’s cart

409.description: Quantity rules rejected the line (OUT_OF_STOCK under STOCK_ONLY policy)

post.description: After login: merge the guest cart (th_cart cookie) into the user cart. Identical variants sum quantities under the rules; the guest cart is deleted and the cookie cleared. Called automatically by the frontend on every successful sign-in.

Quick-order style import: up to 200 { articleNo, quantity } lines. Unknown articles are reported per line; every valid line is added in one transaction. Article numbers accept comma or dot decimals ("111100 0,5" / "111100 0.5").
Pre-flight checkout check: cart non-empty, all items buyable, stock policy satisfied, delivery method offered. Returns issues with stable codes plus a totals preview.

Places the order in ONE transaction: re-prices every line server-side (customer price > tier > list), re-validates stock and min-order rules, recomputes totals, writes order + snapshot items + the first timeline event, decrements stock and clears the cart. The confirmation email is enqueued after the commit. Optional idempotencyKey replays return the original order. Payment methods: INVOICE, REQUEST (offline B2B) and RAZORPAY (behind the razorpayCheckout feature flag).

409.description: Validation failed — details list the per-line issues (OUT_OF_STOCK, ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, ...)

post.description: Verifies a Razorpay checkout callback: HMAC signature over (gatewayOrderId|gatewayPaymentId), receipt binding to our orderNo, then marks the order PAID. Idempotent.

get.description: The caller’s orders, newest first, with item counts. Paginated (?page&pageSize, max 100).
Order detail with line snapshots and the status timeline (OrderEvent rows). Scoped to the caller — other users’ order numbers return ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Puts every line of a past order back into the cart at current prices under the current quantity rules (unknown articles are skipped with a cart warning).

Resolves up to 200 article-number lines (articleNo + quantity) against the live catalog: variant identity, image, list price, min-order/pack rules and the stock policy. Unknown articles are reported per line. Article numbers accept comma or dot decimals.

get.description: Storefront-facing commerce settings: tax rate, standard/express delivery rates and which payment methods the checkout may offer (RAZORPAY follows the feature flag).
Dashboard KPIs: catalog counts, orders + revenue (last 30 days), pending orders, failed imports, latest 5 orders and the low-stock watchlist.
All orders (newest first) with buyer email/name; filters: q (orderNo/po/email), status, paymentStatus.
CSV export (text/csv) of all orders matching the filters (max 50 000 rows).
Order detail with items, timeline and buyer identity.

patch.description: Validated status transition (state machine: PENDING→CONFIRMED→PROCESSING→SHIPPED→DELIVERED; CANCELLED from the first three) and/or notes edit. Writes a timeline event + audit log.

409.description: Invalid transition — details list the allowed ones

post.description: Re-enqueues the order confirmation email.

get.description: User list with company names (ADMIN only); filters: q, role.

patch.description: Activate/deactivate and role assignment (ADMIN only). Self-guarded: you cannot deactivate or demote your own account.

get.description: Company list with user + customer-price counts (ADMIN only).

patch.description: Edit company name / GSTIN / customer number (ADMIN only, audited).

get.description: Audit trail viewer (ADMIN only): newest first, filter by entity or free text.
The full settings document (tax, shipping, stock policy, feature flags) — ADMIN only.

patch.description: Partial settings update validated per key (ADMIN only, audited). tax.ratePercent, shipping.{flatRateInr,freeThresholdInr,note,expressRateInr?}, stock.policy, features.razorpayCheckout.

get.description: Read-only session lookup from the httpOnly refresh cookie (no rotation) — used by server-side guards such as the admin layout.
